battle.name: 昆陽之戰
battle.brief: 公元二十三年六月一日，綠林軍偏將軍劉秀率步騎萬餘馳援昆陽，與九千守軍內外夾擊，大破新朝王邑、王尋主力。莽軍久攻疲敝，遭敢死隊迂迴偷渡昆水直襲大本營，暴雨使滍水暴漲，士卒溺斃以萬數，王尋戰死。卡面的羅馬短劍並未出現在昆陽，代表同時代短兵刺突的路線，與漢軍環首刀同屬刺殺的兵器邏輯。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰雙方是新朝與以綠林軍為主體的更始政權。新朝一方由皇帝王莽坐鎮長安、洛陽，以中央直轄的宿衛與京畿為核心，臨時從天下州郡調兵：潁川、汝南、陳留等地的郡兵被指定為精兵，關中長安的宿衛「勇敢」隨大司空王邑出擊，南線荊州兵由甄阜、梁丘賜率領北上，另有嚴尤、陳茂一部在淯陽方向與綠林周旋。定會洛陽的部隊，《漢書》記四十二萬、《資治通鑑》記四十三萬，號稱百萬，統軍者是王莽的從兄大司空王邑與其弟大司徒王尋。綠林一方是起自荊襄、橫跨江漢與南陽的起義聯盟：起義最初是天鳳四年饑民在綠林山聚集，武裝形成後推舉漢室後裔劉玄為綠林君，二月稱帝、恢復漢制、改元更始；上公王鳳為最高統帥，劉縱屯守西山，馬援、岑彭各將一軍，鄧禹、宗佻、李轶、劉嘉等為骨幹。其地盤由沘水、淯陽一路推進到定陵、郾縣、昆陽三城，兵眾十餘萬，再以犄角之勢進逼宛城。兩邊都不是國家之間的戰爭，而是王朝崩解時，地方軍事集團與受薪給的郡縣兵在同一座城下互相消耗。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Xin dynasty of Wang Mang and the Genglin (Green Forest) insurgents, who had already proclaimed the Gengshi (Renewed) regime. The Xin side fought from Chang'an and Luoyang, with the imperial guards and the capital region at its core, but its strength came from troops levied from every commandery and province: elite contingents were drawn from the commandery armies of Yingchuan, Runan and Chenliu; the valiant men (yonggan) of the Chang'an garrison marched out under the Grand Chancellor Wang Yi; the Jingzhou troops led by Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci joined the southern front; and Yan You with Chen Mao operated against the insurgents near Yuyang. The troops mustered at Luoyang are given as 420,000 in the Hanshu and 430,000, 'called a million', in the Zizhi Tongjian. The field command was held by Wang Yi's cousin Wang Mang and by Wang Mang's brother the Grand Marshal Wang Xun. The Genglin side was an insurgent coalition that grew out of famine in Jingxiang and the Jianghan plain. Its first gathering was a band of hungry peasants who took to the Green Forest hills in the fourth year of Tianfeng; once the band had armed itself it raised Liu Xuan, a descendant of the Han house, to the title of lord of the Green Forest, who in the second month took the throne, restored Han institutions and opened the Gengshi era. Above the army stood the Duke of Chengguo Wang Feng, with Liu Zong holding the western hills, Ma Yuan and Cen Peng each commanding a column, and Deng Yu, Zong Tan, Li Yi and Liu Jia as its backbone. Their power base ran from the Bishui and Yuyang up to Dingling, Yun and Kunyang, with more than a hundred thousand men, poised in a pincer movement against the city of Wan. This was not a war between two states but a collision, during the break-up of a dynasty, between a regional military coalition and salaried commandery levies grinding away at each other below the same city wall.
people: 綠林方面，退居昆陽的偏將軍劉秀是全役樞紐。他力排眾議，說明合兵尚能取勝、分散勢難保全，勸諸將固守孤城；又與驃騎大將軍宗佻、五威將軍李轶乘夜出城，赴定陵、郾縣調集援兵，並派族弟劉嘉潛行入城通消息。決戰時他自將千餘精銳為前鋒反覆衝陣，又以三千名敢死隊迂迴偷渡昆水，直取王邑大本營。謀主鄧禹自穎川隨軍，力主乘勝進攻；上公王鳳與廷尉大將軍王常坐鎮昆陽，統攝全軍；西山大軍的劉縱、馬援、岑彭則在宛城方向接應。新朝方面，發動戰役的大司空王邑恃兵多而輕敵，下令各營勒卒自持、不得擅自出兵，結果大營被襲時諸將不敢出援；大司徒王尋在亂軍中戰死，一說為劉秀所部劉聖所斬；皇帝王莽在長安聞訊震怒，關中亦為之震恐。此外，荊州兵主將甄阜、梁丘賜與在淯陽作戰的嚴尤、陳茂，構成了新朝南線的另一組力量，而漢室的正統旗號，則由劉玄與劉秀這支宗室血脈撐起。
peopleEn: On the insurgent side the hinge figure was the deputy general Liu Xiu, who had withdrawn to Kunyang. He overrode the general assembly's wish to run, arguing that united they might win while scattered they would certainly be destroyed, and pressed the commanders to hold the isolated city; with the Cavalry Commandant Zong Tan and the General of Five Majesties Li Yi he rode out of the city by night to gather reinforcements at Dingling and Yun, and sent his kinsman Liu Jia slipping in to carry word. In the decisive action he led more than a thousand picked men as the vanguard in repeated charges, and took three thousand forlorn souls round by the back of the enemy, fording the Kunshui to strike at Wang Yi's main camp. His adviser Deng Yu, who had joined him in Yingchuan, pressed for an immediate advance. The Duke of Chengguo Wang Feng and the Grand Marshal of the Court of Justice Wang Chang held Kunyang and directed the whole force, while Liu Zong, Ma Yuan and Cen Peng stood ready on the Wan front. On the Xin side the Grand Chancellor Wang Yi, overconfident in his numbers, ordered each camp to hold its men and not to advance without leave; when his main camp was struck the other generals dared not move to help him, and the Grand Marshal Wang Xun was killed in the confusion, one account saying he was cut down by Liu Xiu's officer Liu Sheng. Emperor Wang Mang in Chang'an was thrown into a fury by the news and the whole Guanzhong region shook with fear. The Jingzhou commanders Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci, and Yan You and Chen Mao in the Yuyang area, formed the other half of the Xin line, while the banner of the Han house was carried by the imperial-blooded Liu Xuan and Liu Xiu.
kits: 卡面是一柄西元前一世紀的羅馬短劍，它並未出現在昆陽戰場，卻可以當作同時代短兵技術的標尺：羅馬短劍與漢代的環首刀同屬窄身、雙刃、以刺突為主的近戰兵器，靠盾的邊緣護住手腕、靠刺突的節奏取人，而不是用來揮砍。昆陽兩軍在近身環衛時真正倚重的，正是這類短兵。新朝的裝備以郡兵為主，弩弓、方盾、長矛與環首刀成套配發，攻城則備雲車、地道與投石，糧秣由洛陽、宛城沿汝水流域的車馬輸送，器械數量雖多，卻多由沿途州郡臨時徵發，規格參差。綠林軍是饑民與亡命徒組成的雜牌，除劉秀、岑彭等將領的部曲有較整齊的環首刀、劍與鐵矛外，多數士卒只有麻衣、葛布、削尖的木矛與自製的弓弩，甲胄極少，全靠城垣、房屋與斷壁作掩體。雙方真正共通的裝備不是甲冑，而是雲車、機弩、投石這類攻城器械，以及短兵刺突的近戰武器：決戰前夕，攻城雲車與地道同時推進，卻被守軍以矢石、擂木與夜襲擾亂，而一旦短兵相接，盾緣與刺突的節奏就重新決定了生死的分寸。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman gladius of the first century BC. It never appeared on the Kunyang battlefield, yet it serves as a yardstick for the close-combat technology of the same age: the gladius and the Han ring-pommel dao belong to the same family of narrow, double-edged weapons fought by thrusting rather than by swinging, and they work the same way, the rim of the shield covering the sword hand and the rhythm of the thrust taking the target, rather than any chop of a sabre. At Kunyang, when the two sides closed to grapple range, it was exactly this kind of short weapon that both lines relied on. The Xin's equipment was organised around the commandery levies: crossbows, oblong shields, long pikes and ring-pommel dao issued as sets, with cloud-towers, sapping tunnels and stone-throwers for the siege, and provisions moved by cart and pack animal from Luoyang and Wan along the valley of the Ru river. The materiel was numerous but had been hastily drawn up from the commanderies along the line of march, so its quality was uneven. The Genglin army was a host of famine-stricken peasants and desperate men; apart from the retinues of men such as Liu Xiu and Cen Peng, which had regular ring-pommel dao, swords and iron-tipped spears, most soldiers had only hemp clothing, coarse cloth, sharpened wooden pikes and home-made bows, and hardly any armour at all, so they fought behind city walls, houses and broken walls. What the two sides truly shared was not armour but the siege train - cloud-towers, heavy crossbows, stone-throwers - and the short thrusting weapons of the melee. On the eve of the decision cloud-towers and sapping works were being pushed forward together, only to be thrown into confusion by arrows, stone missiles and night sorties; and once the lines came to grappling range, the shield rim and the rhythm of the thrust settled the matter again.
tactics: 綠林軍的部署是一整套以少擊多的算計。先以王鳳、王常、劉秀所部約二萬人取下昆陽、定陵、郾三縣，使三城互為犄角，並向宛城方向形成包抄。王莽主力南下的消息傳來後，劉秀部退回昆陽，軍中議走，劉秀力主留守，把希望全押在援兵上；同時與宗佻、李轶夜出重圍，到定陵、郾縣收攏步兵、騎兵一萬七千精兵，再分人潛行入城報信，使守軍有底。守城階段，綠林以射擊、擂木與夜襲消耗攻城雲車與地道工程，不與莽軍爭奪城外空地。決戰採兩翼鉗形：劉秀以步騎萬餘自正面逼近，自領千餘精銳反覆衝鋒，斬首千餘以振士氣；同時以三千敢死隊迂迴，偷渡昆水直插王邑大本營，致各營奉令持重不得擅出，援兵無從策應。城內守軍見敵營大亂，乘勢出城截斷退路，潰兵爭相蹈藉，又遇大風飛瓦、暴雨如注，滍水暴漲，涉水者被淹死以萬數，水為之不流。另一說記劉秀命敢死隊決城南堤防，以水灌敵營，方向相同而手段有別。追擊階段，綠林軍逐北至滍陽、洛陽方向，莽軍殘部僅以數千人隨王邑退回關中。
tacticsEn: The Genglin deployment was a complete calculation of how to beat a much larger army. First a force of about twenty thousand under Wang Feng, Wang Chang and Liu Xiu took Kunyang, Dingling and Yun, so that the three cities formed a mutual pincer and could reach towards Wan. When the news came of Wang Mang's main army moving south, Liu Xiu's troops fell back on Kunyang, the assembly voted to abandon it, and Liu Xiu insisted on holding, staking everything on relief; at the same time he and Zong Tan and Li Yi rode out through the encirclement by night, gathered a picked force of seventeen thousand infantry and cavalry at Dingling and Yun, and sent men slipping in to reassure the garrison. In the defensive phase the insurgents refused to fight for open ground outside the walls, and instead wore down the siege works with arrows, stone missiles and night sorties against the cloud-towers and the sapping tunnels. The decisive stroke was a pincer. Liu Xiu closed from the front with more than ten thousand foot and horse, leading a thousand picked men in repeated charges that killed over a thousand of the enemy and lifted the morale of the whole army; at the same time three thousand forlorn souls detoured, forded the Kunshui and drove straight at Wang Yi's main camp, while the other camps, bound by their order to sit on their hands, could not intervene. The garrison in the city, seeing the enemy camp in confusion, surged out to cut the retreat; the fugitives trampled one another, and then a gale tore the tiles away and the rain came down in sheets, the Zhui river rose in spate, those who waded were drowned by the thousand, and the water could not flow for the bodies. Another account says Liu Xiu ordered his forlorn souls to burst the embankment south of the city and drown the enemy camp with the released water - the same purpose, a different means. In the pursuit the insurgents drove the routed enemy back towards Zhuiyang and Luoyang, and only a few thousand men of the Xin army followed Wang Yi back into Guanzhong.
data: 站內此卡年份取公元十七年（天鳳四年，綠林起義興起、荊襄饑民聚眾之年），但決戰本身發生於公元二十三年更始元年；列表編目年同史實年份的差異，以下按正史交代。雙方兵力的記載差距極大，須分層理解。《漢書·王莽傳》記各州郡到洛陽「定會者四十二萬人」，《資治通鑑》作四十三萬、號百萬；東漢初年的《東觀漢紀》作五六萬，《論衡》作三萬。而《後漢書》與《資治通鑑》同樣提到「莽軍到城下者且十萬」，即真正合圍昆陽的兵力約十萬。綠林方面：王鳳、王常、劉秀率約二萬人取三縣，昆陽守軍九千人，宗佻、李轶夜出調得步兵、騎兵一萬七千精兵，劉秀於六月一日率步騎萬餘人馳援，先鋒精銳千餘人一戰斬敵千餘，迂迴敢死隊三千人。損失方面，《後漢書》記新軍「死者數萬」「士卒爭赴，溺死者以萬數，水為不流」，《資治通鑑》則記王邑與數千長安勇敢逃回洛陽；綠林軍自身的損失，據近代整理約二千人。時間線為：二月劉玄稱帝改元更始，三月取昆陽等三縣，三月王莽遣王邑急赴洛陽，五月新軍出潁川、逼近城北並圍城，六月一日決戰，宛城則久攻不下。
dataEn: The card's year on this site is taken as AD 17, the fourth year of Tianfeng, when the Green Forest rising first gathered in Jingxiang, but the decisive battle itself was fought in AD 23, the first year of the Gengshi era; the difference between the year of the catalogue entry and the year of the historical event is set out below from the standard histories. The recorded strengths differ enormously and must be read in layers. The Hanshu, in the biography of Wang Mang, states that the troops which mustered at Luoyang numbered 420,000; the Zizhi Tongjian gives 430,000, 'called a million'; the Dongguan Hanji, compiled in the early Eastern Han, gives fifty to sixty thousand; and the Lunheng gives thirty thousand. The Hou Hanshu and the Zizhi Tongjian alike mention that the army which actually reached the walls was about 100,000, which is the force that really invested Kunyang. On the insurgent side: Wang Feng, Wang Chang and Liu Xiu took the three counties with some twenty thousand men; Kunyang's garrison numbered nine thousand; Zong Tan and Li Yi brought back seventeen thousand picked infantry and cavalry; on the first of June Liu Xiu came up with more than ten thousand foot and horse, his vanguard of over a thousand picked men killing more than a thousand of the enemy in the first charge, while the detached forlorn souls numbered three thousand. On losses, the Hou Hanshu records that tens of thousands of the Xin army were killed and that 'the soldiers ran headlong into the water, those drowned numbered by the thousands, so that the water could not flow'; the Zizhi Tongjian instead records that Wang Yi returned to Luoyang with several thousand of the valiant men of Chang'an. Modern compilations put the insurgents' own losses at roughly two thousand. The timeline runs: in the second month Liu Xuan was proclaimed emperor and the Gengshi era opened; in the third month the three counties including Kunyang were taken, and Wang Mang sent Wang Yi post-haste to Luoyang; in the fifth month the Xin army came out through Yingchuan, closed to the north of the city and began the investment; on the first of June came the decision, after which the city of Wan proved hard to reduce.
cause: 昆陽之戰的起因，是王莽新朝統治的全面失衡。天鳳、地皇年間幣制屢改、五次易鑄，錢文與輕重不一，農民以鳥篆錢交易，實際被剝削更重；同時加派稅賦、徵發徭役、律令苛刻，刑罰與連坐日增，饑荒與疫病並行，良田被兼併，農民淪為奴婢者比比皆是。對外則連年用兵於西域與西南，徵兵索糧，轉輸不息，州牧太守因失職被誅，吏治益壞。天鳳四年即公元十七年，饑民在荊襄的綠林山一帶聚集為盜，至地皇年間人數以萬計，蔓延到南陽、汝南、江夏、隨國，與山東的赤眉、南方的隗囂部、蜀地任氏等起義互為聲援。劉玄被推為綠林君、恢復漢室改元更始，是為了給這群烏合之眾一個正統的名號。王莽因此傾力集兵南下，先以荊州、關中兩路掃平沘水、淯陽，再以大軍直指宛城，企圖一舉撲滅荊襄勢力，於是有了昆陽城下的對峙。
causeEn: The proximate cause of Kunyang was the general breakdown of Wang Mang's rule. During the Tianfeng and Dihuang years the coinage was reformed and recast again and again, five changes in all, the inscriptions and weights of the coins no longer agreeing, so that the peasants who traded in bird-seal script coin were in truth robbed even more severely. At the same time taxes were increased, corvée labour was levied, the statutes were harsh, punishments and collective liability grew heavier, famine and plague ran together, good fields were swallowed up, and peasants were turned into slaves in great numbers. Abroad, war in the Western Regions and in the southwest went on year after year, draining away men and grain and leaving the roads no peace; incompetent commandery governors and prefects were executed one after another, which made the administration worse rather than better. In the fourth year of Tianfeng, that is 17 AD, hungry peasants gathered in the Green Forest hills of Jingxiang as a band of brigands; by the Dihuang years their numbers ran into tens of thousands and spread into Nanyang, Runan, Jiangxia and the Sui region, answering one another with the Chimei rising in the east, the forces of Wei Xiao in the south and the Ren clan in Shu. Liu Xuan was raised as lord of the Green Forest and the Han house restored under the Gengshi era so that this unruly host would have a legitimate name. Wang Mang therefore gathered every man he could and drove south: first the troops of Jingzhou and of Guanzhong swept away the insurgents at the Bishui and Yuyang, then the great army pointed straight at Wan, aiming to extinguish the Jingxiang movement in one stroke - and so the two sides came to stand against each other below the walls of Kunyang.
impact: 昆陽一勝，等於把新朝的柱石抽掉。王莽耗盡關中、州郡與南征資源集合而成的四十餘萬大軍一朝潰散，兵器、糧秣、輜重盡為綠林所獲，王莽再也無力平定四方起義。消息傳出，關中、洛陽、三輔震動，郡縣太守爭殺新朝官吏、改用漢年號，響應者比比皆是；更始政權遣王匡攻洛陽，申屠建與李松急攻武關，數月而長安城破，王莽死於未央宮前的新朝宮中，新朝覆亡。對劉秀而言，此役是從偏將軍躍升為一方盟主的轉捩點：士氣、器械、人心皆集中於一身，隨後受命經略河北，於二十五年在鄗登基，建立東漢，開啟漢室中興。此役更被後世兵家視為以少勝多、避實擊虛、夜襲敵營的典範，昆陽故城也因之成為千載名勝，歷代詠史之作反覆詠歎其以孤城挫巨師。
impactEn: The victory at Kunyang was, in effect, the removal of the pillar on which the Xin dynasty rested. The army of more than four hundred thousand men, assembled at the cost of everything Guanzhong, every province and the whole southern campaign, collapsed in a single day; its weapons, provisions and baggage were taken by the insurgents, and Wang Mang was never able to raise a force that could put the revolts down again. As the news spread, Guanzhong, Luoyang and the Three Commanderies shook, and commandery governors and prefects vied with one another to kill the Xin's officials and revert to the Han calendar, so that the response came from every quarter. The Gengshi regime sent Wang Kuang against Luoyang and Shen Tu Jian with Li Song against the Wuguan Pass, and within months the city of Chang'an fell and Wang Mang was killed in the palace of the old Xin, ending the dynasty. For Liu Xiu the battle was the turning point that lifted him from deputy general to a commander in his own right: morale, materiel and renown all gathered in one place, and he was then sent to take charge of the northern regions, crowning himself at Jao in the twenty-fifth year and founding the Eastern Han, so opening the restoration of the Han house. Later military writers took the battle as a model of defeating a many with a few, of striking where the enemy is weak and of the night attack on the enemy camp, and the old city of Kunyang has been a celebrated site ever since, praised in poem after poem for a lone city that broke a gigantic host.
result: 結果是新朝軍主力在昆陽城下崩潰。王尋戰死，王邑僅與數千長安勇敢逃回洛陽，關中為之震恐；諸營潰散時互相踐踏，積屍遍野，滍水為溺死者不流，新軍的銳氣與物資一併留在昆陽城下。綠林軍乘勝追擊，並以昆陽、定陵、郾三縣為基地進逼宛城，劉縱見大勢已去而出降，劉秀併其眾，兵勢逾十餘萬；更始政權隨後分兵四出，王匡攻洛陽，申屠建、李松攻武關，終於促成長安之破與王莽之死，新朝覆亡，漢室中興的序幕由此拉開。昆陽一役的意義不止於一城一地：它證明新朝四十萬大軍不過是紙面數字，王莽就此喪失最後一批堪用的精銳，再無力整合四方兵馬，也把劉秀的名字送到天下人眼前，此後河北、關中、中原的爭奪格局已定。
resultEn: The result was the collapse of the main Xin army below the walls of Kunyang. Wang Xun was killed, and Wang Yi got back to Luoyang with only a few thousand of the valiant men of Chang'an, so that Guanzhong shook with fear. The broken camps trampled one another as they fled, the fields were heaped with bodies, and the Zhui river could not flow for the drowned; the Xin's edge and its supplies were both left behind at Kunyang. The insurgents pursued, used Kunyang, Dingling and Yun as their base to close on the city of Wan, and when Liu Zong saw how the wind had turned he came out and surrendered, so that Liu Xiu took over his troops and more than a hundred thousand men rallied to him. The Gengshi regime then dispatched forces in several directions - Wang Kuang against Luoyang, Shen Tu Jian and Li Song against the Wuguan - and within a few months Chang'an fell and Wang Mang died, ending the Xin dynasty and opening the first chapter of the Han restoration. The meaning of Kunyang reaches beyond one city and one day: it showed that the four hundred thousand men of the Xin were a figure on paper, and it carried Liu Xiu's name before the whole empire, so that the struggle over Hebei, Guanzhong and the Central Plain had already taken shape. What ended at Kunyang was not only a besieging army but the last of the Xin's seasoned troops, and what began there was the armed rise that carried the Han house back to the throne.
